hero.title: Trade useful things with your local community — no money required.
hero.description: Barter Platform helps neighbors, collectors, and families exchange items they already have for things they actually need. Start with a listing, browse local offers, and arrange safe public exchanges.

list.title: List what you already have
list.description: Create a draft, pick the right template, add photos, and publish when the listing is ready for offers.

discover.title: Browse community listings
discover.description: Search active items, save favorites, and keep useful searches so you can spot good matches faster.

offer.title: Send an offer and complete the swap
offer.description: Propose a trade, keep the conversation on-platform, and confirm the exchange after both sides finish.

cashless.title: No cash required
cashless.description: The platform is designed around item-for-item, gift, and negotiable barter flows instead of payments.

local.title: Local and community focused
local.description: Exchange by city or neighborhood and keep listings centered around approximate public meeting areas.

trust.title: Trust and safety reminders
trust.description: Use public exchange spots, keep communication inside the platform, and review completed trades to help the community.

items.publicPlace: Meet in public, well-lit locations whenever possible.
items.keepMessages: Keep trade details in platform messages so both sides have one clear record.
items.protectPrivacy: Share only approximate exchange areas in listings — never your exact home address.

footer.title: Ready to try your first barter?
footer.description: Create an account to start your activation checklist, publish your first listing, and send feedback as you explore the beta.
